subject: Supplier onboarding: Novapay — DPA, SOC 2, subprocessors and PO steps
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novapay.com>, procurement@novapay.com
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Supplier onboarding: Novapay — DPA, SOC 2, subprocessors and PO steps

Hi Elena / Novapay procurement team,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier — excited to get this live. To complete Redwood's procurement intake and start the PO process, can you please share the following items: 

- Executable DPA (DocuSign link preferred) so we can route to legal.
- SOC 2 Type II report (or a secure link we can download). We need the latest 12-month coverage.
- Current subprocessor list (spreadsheet preferred) and any data residency notes.
- Remit and invoicing instructions so our finance team can create a PO (billing address, tax info, preferred PO format).

I've attached our standard onboarding form to speed things up (Redwood_Onboarding_Form.pdf). If you already have a procurement portal or a preferred PO template, point me to it and we'll follow. Ideally we'd have the DPA/PO flow confirmed this week so we can schedule provisioning.

Quick answers that will help us: do you require a signed DPA before we start trial traffic? What's your typical turnaround on PO issuance once the invoice is sent?

Thanks — looping in Lauren and Karthik for procurement/legal intake.

Best,

Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachment: Redwood_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf, 210KB)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: Novapay — DPA, SOC 2, subprocessors and PO steps

Marcus — thanks for pulling this together. A couple quick procurement/legal checks before we push to vendor: 

- DPA: we require countersignature (DocuSign ok). Ask for standard Data Processing Addendum + appendix for subprocessors.
- SOC 2: request the full Type II report or at least a read-only link and AICPA bridge letter if there are scoping exclusions.
- Subprocessors: need names, locations, and purpose. If any subprocessors handle customer data in EU, flag for privacy review.
- PO: our finance team needs vendor legal name, remit address, W-9 (or W-8 if non-US), and preferred invoice email.

I'll draft a one-paragraph checklist we can paste into the vendor reply.

- Lauren
Director, Commercial Operations
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novapay.com>

Cc: procurement@novapay.com, accounts@novapay.com
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: Novapay — DPA, SOC 2, subprocessors and PO steps

Hi Marcus — great to meet you. Thanks for the clear list. Please find items below and notes on the PO flow.

1) DPA: we have prepared the DPA and initiated a DocuSign envelope for Redwood. Please sign here: https://docusign.com/Signing/NovaPayDPA
- Attachment: NovaPay_DPA_Signature_Request.pdf (application/pdf, 145KB) — draft DPA with our standard annex.

2) SOC 2: we host the most recent Type II report at a secure link: https://novapay.secure-docs.com/soc2/2026-type2
- If you need a download we can provide a temporary token. If your legal team prefers, we can also provide the SOC 2 auditor contact for a controls call.
- Note: report covers payment processing and data platform scope (no third-party KYC provider).

3) Subprocessors: attached spreadsheet lists current subprocessors, locations, and purpose.
- Attachment: NovaPay_Subprocessors_List.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 22KB)

4) PO / invoicing: Novapay policy is to receive a PO before the first invoice for new corporate customers. Steps: 
  - Redwood sends PO to procurement@novapay.com including Redwood legal name and billing address and Redwood tax ID.
  - We will return a vendor setup confirmation and vendor code within 3 business days.
  - Invoices should be emailed to accounts@novapay.com and reference the PO number.
  - Attachment: NovaPay_W9.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB) — vendor tax form for your records.

Estimated timeline: once DocuSign is signed and PO submitted, vendor setup and first invoice acceptance usually take 3–5 business days.

If you want, we can include a short Master Services Agreement redline track, but the DPA is typically sufficient to start provisioning for pilot traffic.

Let me know if you want the SOC 2 download token or want us to schedule an auditor controls call.

Regards,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Procurement
NovaPay
elena.ruiz@novapay.com
+1 (212) 555-0124

Attachments: NovaPay_DPA_Signature_Request.pdf, NovaPay_Subprocessors_List.xlsx, NovaPay_W9.pdf

Karthik / Lauren — Novapay sent the materials and a DocuSign link for the DPA (see Elena's email below). They require a PO before the first invoice.

Action items: 
- Karthik: can you raise a PO for NovaPay using the legal name and remit in their W9 (attached to Elena's email)? If you can assign a PO number I will send that to procurement@novapay.com today.
- Lauren: once PO is created I'll route DocuSign to legal for countersignature — please advise if we need the SOC 2 download token or auditor contact before countersigning.

Copying the vendor text for convenience.

Thanks — Marcus
